original_prompt: Let's review and validate our system to ensure that we are able to log into our services using keycloak.  Let's validate that the authentication is being used where our online services are concerned and let's ensure that all of our services are hardened and secured using keycloak.  Let's review the current Sulcus website to ensure it is crystal clear what people are seeing at a glance, how it works, what it's meant to do, how it does it, and what it offers.  Let's ensure that the marketing site is demonstrating all it can and explaining all it can in as clean and concise iconographical language as possible.  Our system must absolutely leverage Keycloak in all its glory; let's ensure we are leveraging all the official libraries and absolutely must not be using custom mechanisms where native official mechanisms exist.  Let's ensure we implement a framework that let's a user manage their account through our application.  Ensure that we have a complete host of pages with all the quality of life bells and whistles necessary for an in app integration of stripe services such that a user can register, purchase a subscription, manage their subscription, their organization and seats, and see their usage and quota all as easily as possible.  As a god tier cto, orchestrate a team of claude cli invocations to performs the tasks as you track progress and rinse repeat until our market portal is a proper web application with user accounts, management bells and whistles, subscriptions and in app management of, organizations and seats invitations, and let's ensure we have unit tests and validations that demonstrate our platform functions as expected.
